lines.zh: 我踩碎枯枝，夜里响得很远
lines.en: I crush dead branches and the sound carries far in the night

lines.zh: 头上的角把低枝拨开了
lines.en: My horns push the low branches aside
I do not walk fast, but I never stop
The deeper the night, the heavier my tread

lines.zh: 针叶林的夜风里有我的味道
lines.en: The night wind in the taiga carries my scent

lines.zh: 我拖着一根木棒，磨着地面
lines.en: I drag a club and it grinds on the ground
That shadow wider than a tree is me
The moss goes silent under my feet

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，圈子越收越小
lines.en: I circle you and the circle keeps tightening
A pine needle is caught on my horn tip
My breath comes out white

lines.zh: 走夜路的时候别落在最后
lines.en: When walking at night, never be last

lines.zh: 我站着不动，也在盯着你
lines.en: I stand still, and I am still watching you
My hands hang low and my knuckles still crack
The night is long and I am not in a hurry
I scratch the base of my horn, it itches
The snow under my feet has melted
I open my mouth and show my fangs

lines.zh: 听见林子里有动静，我偏了偏头
lines.en: Something moves in the trees and I tilt my head

lines.zh: 我把木棒换到另一只手
lines.en: I shift the club to my other hand
Standing here alone scares off the small animals

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，一动不动
lines.en: I count your steps without moving at all
My horns feel cold, it is the night wind

lines.zh: 我盯着火堆，眼睛比火亮
lines.en: I stare at the fire and my eyes shine brighter

lines.zh: 脚跟在地上蹭出两个坑
lines.en: My heels have worn two pits in the ground

lines.zh: 安静些，我在听你的心跳
lines.en: Be quiet, I am listening to your heartbeat
I am not tired, I can afford to wait

lines.zh: 树影晃了一下，那是我在动
lines.en: The treeline shifted, that was me moving
This stretch of forest is mine to watch

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，牙全露出来
lines.en: I yawn and all my teeth show
You are shorter than me, that is good

lines.zh: 我把脸凑近，让你看清角
lines.en: I bring my face close so you can see the horns
You are shivering, I can smell it
Lift your head when you speak
These eyes can see your warmth

lines.zh: 别躲，我不喜欢追着人看
lines.en: Do not hide, I dislike chasing a face
You carry the smell of iron on you

lines.zh: 我偏头打量你，像看一块肉
lines.en: I tilt my head and size you up like meat

lines.zh: 站直了，让我看清你的脖子
lines.en: Stand tall and let me see your neck
What are you grinning at? Grinning will not help

lines.zh: 我伸出舌头舔了舔嘴角
lines.en: I run my tongue along the corner of my mouth

lines.zh: 看着我的角，别看我脚下
lines.en: Look at my horns, not at my feet

lines.zh: 我这脸长得不好看，但够用
lines.en: My face is not handsome, but it works

lines.zh: 你的名字我不问，反正要死
lines.en: I will not ask your name, you will die anyway
Pain? Even oni feel it, and I smile
That one scraped the skin

lines.zh: 我低吼了一声，退了半步
lines.en: I growl low and take half a step back
That blow had real force in it
The blood is black, do not fear
I grin through clenched teeth
Bone is fine, flesh is not
A small wound in exchange for your hand

lines.zh: 我晃了晃脑袋，把疼甩掉
lines.en: I shake my head to throw off the pain
Again, I am still standing
And what does one feed an oni?
I sniff it and frown
That much would not fill a gap in my teeth
Hold it higher, I cannot see it

lines.zh: 我不是来吃饭的，是来抓人的
lines.en: I did not come to eat, I came for you
The hand offering it is shaking
I take it and crush it in my fist

lines.zh: 这个东西闻起来像人做的
lines.en: This smells like something a human made

lines.zh: 我凑近了，獠牙快碰到你的手
lines.en: I lean in, my fangs nearly touch your hand
I can chase you after I eat
Bumping into me? You are delivering yourself
I shove you back with my shoulder

lines.zh: 骨头撞骨头，你疼我不疼
lines.en: Bone on bone, you hurt and I do not
Do not stand so close, I get hungry easily
My horn nearly caught your eye

lines.zh: 我退了半步，是给你机会跑
lines.en: I stepped back to give you a chance to run

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的肩膀记住了吧
lines.en: That collision, your shoulder will remember
I do not budge, I am like a stone

lines.zh: 你撞上来那一刻，我笑了
lines.en: When you hit me, I smiled
Bump me once more and I will grab you
Only my own kind do not fear me

lines.zh: 你也有角吗？没有就走开
lines.en: Do you have horns? No? Then walk on

lines.zh: 凑过来之前，先看看我的牙
lines.en: Look at my teeth before you come closer

lines.zh: 鬼的亲近是拿棍子打招呼
lines.en: For an oni, affection starts with a club
I lower my head so you will not touch the horns
This face has made children cry
Your hands are too soft, I dare not hold them

lines.zh: 想听我说好话？先挨一棍
lines.en: Want kind words? Take a club first

lines.zh: 夜里站在一起，就算作伴了
lines.en: Standing together in the night counts as company

lines.zh: 我鼻子里哼了一声，那是同意
lines.en: A snort from my nose, that is agreement

lines.zh: 我弯腰，手指粗得夹不住
lines.en: I bend down and my fingers are too thick to pinch it

lines.zh: 捡铁粒？我捡起来扔着玩
lines.en: Iron nuggets? I pick them up to toss around
What falls on the ground, I see first
This is hard, it will not bite through

lines.zh: 我抓起来，塞进腰间的袋子
lines.en: I grab it and stuff it in the pouch at my waist
A book? I cannot read, but paper burns
The gilded box is mine, and I will not pick the lock

lines.zh: 我把它举到眼前，看了半天
lines.en: I hold it up to my eyes and study it a while

lines.zh: 手沾了灰，随便擦在腿上
lines.en: My hands are dusty, I wipe them on my leg

lines.zh: 我捡东西从来不弯腰太久
lines.en: I never stay bent over long for a pickup
You have the warmth of the living on you
I raise my hand and the club points at you
Found you, do not leave
My nose caught the iron smell
My steps stop three paces from you

lines.zh: 夜里闯进来的，都是我的
lines.en: Whatever walks in at night is mine
You looked back, so let us begin
I lick my teeth and move forward slowly

lines.zh: 角尖朝下，冲着你的胸口
lines.en: My horn tips angle down at your chest

lines.zh: 这一片林子，没东西能跑掉
lines.en: Nothing escapes this stretch of forest

lines.zh: 我咧开嘴，喉咙里滚了一声
lines.en: I grin and a growl rolls in my throat

lines.zh: 你身上有香味，我要闻闻
lines.en: You smell of something, I want a closer sniff

lines.zh: 我追得不快，可从不停下
lines.en: I do not chase fast, but I never stop
Run then, I will follow the footprints

lines.zh: 我每一步都落在你的路线上
lines.en: Every step of mine lands on your trail

lines.zh: 树挡不住我，我直接撞过去
lines.en: Trees do not stop me, I charge right through
Getting closer now, you can hear it, right

lines.zh: 我把木棒在手上转了转
lines.en: I spin the club once in my hand

lines.zh: 别往坡上跑，那边没有路
lines.en: Do not head uphill, there is no path there
You are gasping, and I hear it clearly

lines.zh: 我经过的地方雪都踩黑了
lines.en: The snow turns dark where I pass
Do not look back, you will trip

lines.zh: 我绕到前面去了，你不知道
lines.en: I have circled ahead, and you do not know it

lines.zh: 林子就这么大，你能去哪儿
lines.en: The forest is only so big, where can you go

lines.zh: 我一边走一边嗅，方向没错
lines.en: I walk and sniff as I go, the direction is right
The club comes down on your legs
I slam a fist into your armor
The horns come at you, you can only retreat
Got you, do not struggle
I slap you across the back with one palm
Take this blow and your legs will feel heavy
I bite down and my teeth clack
Your breathing is slowing, is it not
I drive my elbow through your shield

lines.zh: 再来一下，你就起不来了
lines.en: One more and you will not get up

lines.zh: 夜里针叶林多了个影子
lines.en: A shape has joined the taiga tonight

lines.zh: 我从树干后走出来，角先露
lines.en: I step from behind a trunk, horns first

lines.zh: 地面被踩出一个坑，我站定了
lines.en: The ground takes a dent as I plant my feet
The wind changed, that is my arrival
On a snowy night, a pair of red eyes joins

lines.zh: 我抖了抖肩，松针落了一地
lines.en: I shake my shoulders and needles rain down
This forest is mine tonight
No need to search, I come out on my own
The snow gives way under my first step

lines.zh: 我在林间站直，头顶碰到树枝
lines.en: I stand tall and my head meets the branch

lines.zh: 远处传来一声闷响，是我落地
lines.en: A dull thud far off, that was me landing

lines.zh: 角上的霜还没化，我就到了
lines.en: The frost on my horns has not melted and I am here

lines.zh: 夜里别独自行走，我提醒过
lines.en: Do not walk alone at night, I did warn you

lines.zh: 树影动了一下，你就该跑了
lines.en: When the shadows shift, you should already run
Fire swept over me and I scowl and back off

lines.zh: 摔下去的时候，角先着地
lines.en: My horns hit first on the way down
The water is too deep and I swim poorly
The blast leaves my ears ringing
Something has sunk into my shoulder

lines.zh: 这股咒力挠得我骨头痒
lines.en: That magic makes my bones itch
Hunger has my hands shaking
The lightning hit me and half of me went numb

lines.zh: 虚空里没地面，我踩空了
lines.en: There is no ground in the void and I missed my step
